properties.Name: Profile visibility: public flag respected
properties.Preconditions: Profile exists with visibility set to public
properties.Steps:
1) Create profile with public visibility
2) GET /profiles/:id
3) Assert exposed fields match visibility rules
properties.Expected Result: Public profile fields are returned; private fields are hidden

properties.Name: Profile visibility: private flag hides fields
properties.Preconditions: Profile exists with visibility set to private
properties.Steps:
1) Create profile with private visibility
2) GET /profiles/:id
3) Assert sensitive fields are not returned
properties.Expected Result: Private profile returns limited fields only

properties.Name: Profiles CRUD: create student profile success
properties.Steps:
1) POST /profile with valid student payload
2) Assert 201 and response body matches schema
3) GET created entity to verify persistence
properties.Expected Result: Profile is created and retrievable with correct fields

properties.Name: Profiles CRUD: validation error on missing required fields
properties.Steps:
1) POST /profile with missing required fields
2) Assert 400 and validation error details

properties.Name: Profiles update: concurrent updates resolve safely
properties.Preconditions: Existing profile; ability to fire two PATCHes rapidly
properties.Steps:
1) PATCH /profile/:id (change A)
2) PATCH /profile/:id (change B) quickly after
3) Assert final state consistent and conflicts handled (e.g., 409 or merge strategy)
properties.Expected Result: No data loss; conflicts are prevented or clearly signaled

properties.Name: Profiles list: pagination returns stable results
properties.Steps:
1) GET /profiles?page=1&pageSize=10
2) GET /profiles?page=2&pageSize=10
3) Ensure no duplicates; total counts match

properties.Name: Search: returns results by keyword

3) Validate result shape
properties.Expected Result: JSON array with expected fields and count

properties.Name: Search: empty query returns 400

properties.Name: Admin: promote-admin.js grants admin role
properties.Preconditions: User exists; script connectivity to DB configured
properties.Steps:
1) Run script with target user
2) Verify role/flags updated in DB
3) Verify AdminProfile record created/linked
properties.Expected Result: User has admin role and admin profile present

properties.Name: Admin: demote-admin.js revokes admin role
properties.Steps:
1) Run script with admin user
2) Verify role/flags updated in DB
3) Verify admin-specific access removed

properties.Name: Messaging: send message via API publishes event
properties.Steps:
1) POST /messages with valid payload
2) Assert 200 response
3) Verify topic event produced

properties.Name: Messaging: fetch conversation messages
properties.Steps:
1) GET /messages?conversationId=...
2) Assert 200 and array sorted by createdAt
3) Validate message schema
properties.Notes: Check limits and pagination if supported

properties.Name: Messaging: reject empty message body
properties.Steps:
1) POST /messages with empty content
2) Expect 400 validation error

properties.Name: Kafka: producer publishes correct topic and key
properties.Steps:
1) Trigger publish
2) Inspect message metadata (topic, key)
3) Assert conforms to contract
properties.Expected Result: Message appears on expected topic with correct key

properties.Name: Kafka: consumer processes events idempotently
properties.Preconditions: Kafka running; ability to replay same event
properties.Steps:
1) Produce duplicate event(s)
2) Assert consumer handles once-only side effects
3) Verify no duplicate DB writes

properties.Name: Redis: client connectivity and basic set/get
properties.Steps:
1) SET key=value
2) GET key
3) Assert value matches

properties.Name: Event Bus: dispatches 'message.created' to subscribers
properties.Steps:
1) Publish 'message.created'
2) Assert subscriber invoked with payload
3) Verify side-effect or ack
properties.Expected Result: All subscribers receive the event once

properties.Name: Events API: server/routes/events.js responds to POST
properties.Steps:
1) POST /events with minimal valid payload
2) Assert 200/202 (as designed)
3) Verify downstream side effects if any
properties.Expected Result: Events endpoint accepts and processes inputs

properties.Name: Messaging: rate-limit or spam control (if enabled)
properties.Steps:
1) Burst send messages
2) Observe 429 after threshold
3) Check retry-after headers

properties.Name: Messaging: unauthorized send returns error (if auth in place)
properties.Steps:
1) POST /messages without auth
2) Expect 401/403 per policy

properties.Name: Opportunities: create and list
properties.Steps:
1) Create opportunity (API or model)
2) List opportunities
3) Assert new record appears

properties.Name: Applications: submit to opportunity (no duplicate)
properties.Steps:
1) Submit application once
2) Attempt duplicate submit
3) Expect 409 or validation error

properties.Name: Subscriptions: create and assign plan
properties.Steps:
1) Create subscription for user
2) Assign plan
3) Verify entitlement fields
properties.Expected Result: User has active subscription with plan reference

properties.Name: Skills: tag and search by skill
properties.Steps:
1) Tag profile with skill X
2) GET /search?q=skill:X (or equivalent)
3) Assert matching profiles returned

properties.Name: Education: add entry to profile
properties.Steps:
1) POST education to profile
2) GET profile
3) Verify education array includes new item

properties.Name: Experience: add entry to profile
properties.Steps:
1) POST experience to profile
2) GET profile
3) Verify experience array includes new item

properties.Name: AnalyticsEvent: track message sent event
properties.Steps:
1) Send message
2) Verify analytics event persisted with correct attributes
3) Ensure no PII leakage in event
properties.Expected Result: Analytic event stored and scrubbed per policy

properties.Name: Frontend: theme toggle applies semantic tokens
properties.Steps:
1) Click ThemeToggle
2) Inspect DOM for bg-background/text-foreground
3) Verify tokens update consistently

properties.Name: Frontend: search input debounces requests
properties.Steps:
1) Type quickly in search box
2) Assert limited number of API calls
3) Verify results update after pause

properties.Name: Frontend: message composer disables send on empty
properties.Steps:
1) Ensure input empty
2) Verify Send disabled
3) Type text -> Send enabled

properties.Name: A11y: keyboard navigation focus order is logical
properties.Preconditions: App renders header, main content, footer
properties.Steps:
1) Use Tab/Shift+Tab to navigate
2) Verify focus moves header -> main -> footer logically
3) Ensure no focus traps
properties.Expected Result: Predictable focus order with visible focus ring

properties.Name: A11y: modals and menus trap focus properly
properties.Steps:
1) Open modal/menu
2) Tab cycles within component
3) Escape closes and returns focus to trigger
properties.Expected Result: No background focus, proper trap and restore

properties.Name: A11y: screen reader labels for interactive elements
properties.Steps:
1) Inspect buttons/links/inputs
2) Verify aria-label or accessible name present
3) Confirm icons have aria-hidden when decorative
properties.Expected Result: All interactive controls have accessible names

properties.Name: A11y: color contrast meets WCAG AA in light/dark
properties.Steps:
1) Check primary text vs background
2) Check buttons/links states
3) Verify AA contrast in both themes

properties.Name: A11y: prefers-reduced-motion respected
properties.Steps:
1) Enable reduced motion in OS
2) Reload app
3) Verify animations minimized

properties.Name: A11y: skip-to-content link works
properties.Steps:
1) Tab from top of page
2) Activate skip link
3) Focus jumps to main content
properties.Expected Result: Keyboard users can bypass nav quickly

properties.Name: A11y: form errors announced via ARIA live regions
properties.Steps:
1) Submit invalid form
2) Screen reader announces error summary
3) Error linked to fields via aria-describedby

properties.Name: A11y: responsive zoom up to 200% without loss
properties.Preconditions: Use browser zoom or system scaling
properties.Steps:
1) Zoom to 200%
2) Verify no overlap/cut-off
3) Interact with core features

properties.Name: A11y: focus visible across all interactive states
properties.Steps:
1) Tab through links/buttons/inputs
2) Verify visible focus ring meets contrast
3) Check in both themes

properties.Name: A11y: images/icons have alt or are hidden
properties.Steps:
1) Inspect images/icons
2) Ensure meaningful alt text or aria-hidden
3) Decorative images not announced
properties.Expected Result: No extraneous announcements by screen readers

properties.Name: Uploads: image upload succeeds and persists
properties.Preconditions: Upload endpoint available; storage path writable
properties.Steps:
1) POST image file
2) Assert 200 and file metadata
3) Verify file exists in server/uploads/
properties.Expected Result: File stored and retrievable via expected path/url
properties.Notes: Adjust Feature path to exact route when known

properties.Name: Uploads: file type whitelist enforced
properties.Steps:
1) Upload disallowed type (e.g., exe)
2) Assert 400 with validation error
